## Original assets

Mascots, music, sounds and icons are original works of the Hoppy project, under its MIT licence.

## Not distributed

Used only to build or test Hoppy, not shipped to users:

- Python reference implementation and tools (`tools/`): Python standard library only.
- Portal build: segno, fontTools, brotli (run by `tools/site.py`; only their output — a QR code and WOFF2 conversions of the fonts above — is published).
- Tests and audits: JUnit, kotlin-test, Playwright, axe-core, Rust dev-dependencies.
- Build tools: Rust toolchain, Gradle and the Android Gradle Plugin, Xcode/XcodeGen, cargo-deb, Inno Setup (jrsoftware.org; its setup program is part of the Windows installer under the Inno Setup License).

System components used by the apps but not distributed with them (each under its vendor's terms):

- Windows: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (part of Windows / installed by Microsoft).
- Linux: WebKitGTK, GTK, D-Bus, zenity/kdialog, curl/wget (system packages).
- macOS and iOS: Apple system frameworks (AppKit, WebKit, UIKit, Foundation…).
- Android: the Android platform libraries.
